trap.label: would após if
trap.wrong: If I would have known, I would have called.
trap.right: Had I known, I would have called.
trap.why: O brasileiro usa o futuro do pretérito (“se eu teria sabido”). Em inglês, nunca would na oração condicional; use had + sujeito + pp.

mcq.q: ___ I known, I would have called.
Had we ___ , we would have won.

opts: Had she known, she would have called.
Had she knew, she would call.

fix.wrong: Had I knew, I would have called.
fix.right: Had I known, I would have called.

fix.wrong: Should rates will rise, we sell.
fix.right: Should rates rise, we will sell.

fix.wrong: Would I known, I would have called.

rewrite.prompt: Inverta: “If I had known, I would have called.”
rewrite.answer: Had I known, I would have called.

rewrite.prompt: Inverta: “If rates should rise, we will sell.”
